Why are Korean convenience stores like small restaurants?

Korean convenience stores have hot-water dispensers, microwaves and places to sit, so you can eat cup noodles or a boxed meal right there even late at night; this explains why, in Korea where many people live alone and many use them at night, 24-hour convenience stores have come to serve as small restaurants, and introduces the unspoken rules to follow when using the seating.
